renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Fill up fast to the crown-top, snap the brow-toss bridge — mind gone thought-free, and everything pours out past it. Or picture peacock feathers, bright shapes, rings, fivefold open space — and step through the highest open straight into the heart.
Wherever a thought lands — open, wall, highest, vessel — the self melts there and gives gifts. Or set the mind inside the skull, eyes half-shut, and let its firmness mark the highest mark.

Feel the middle channel, thin as a lotus-fiber, standing midmost — through the sky inside, God shines. Block the eyes with the hands, split the brow, hold the drop in the middle — supreme standing. Then the fire-fleck on the forehead, the drop at the heart's far end: sit with it, melting.

Hear the unstruck hum, the vessel-ear, the broken roar like a river — bathe in word-brahman and reach the highest. Draw out the holy hum to its end and rest in the open — by the open, by the highest power, she walks into openness.
Take any letter-sound and hold both its ends — its start and its finish — as open. Made of open by the open, the man himself turns open-formed.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Flood it to the crown, snap the brow-bridge — mind wiped thought-free and everything launches past it. Or run the visuals: peacock feathers, shapes, rings, five voids deep — then step through the top void straight into the heart.
Anywhere thought parks — open, wall, top floor, vessel — self dissolves on the spot and pays out. Or stash the mind in the skull, half-mast eyes, and let the lock-in mark the highest mark.

Middle channel, lotus-fiber thin, dead center — through the inner sky, God comes through. Hands over eyes, brow split, drop parked midmost — supreme standing. Then the fire-fleck on the brow, the drop at the heart's far edge: sit in it, melting.

Unstruck hum, vessel-ear, busted sound like a river coming down — soak in word-brahman, touch the highest. Stretch the hum to its tail and park in the open — by the open, by top power, she goes full open.
Grab any letter-sound and hold its head and its tail as open. Open on open makes open — the guy turns open-formed.
